full_details: Before the play the page had four couples in one colour, and the Worthies losing their names, and it still ended on the laugh. At two you played. Walking home under a half moon you tried the new man three ways, each shorter. He comes in black, from her father's court, says half a line, and she ends it. They do not marry today. A twelvemonth. You said Heminges will call it no ending, and that it is the only ending. You stopped on a doorstep. At home you wrote the entrance, paced the six steps of the chamber, and left the half-line empty after The king your father. Mistress Ansell would have heard a murmur. You did not fill the line. You are well.
one_sentence: You played Fair Em, and on the walk home you brought a messenger in black.
title: Played Fair Em and brought a messenger in
